recommendation: Provide resource navigation and psychosocial support for heart failure patients
implementation_steps: Assess social needs and connect patients to community resources
Address housing instability, food insecurity, and transportation barriers
Provide counseling for adjustment to chronic illness
Address caregiver burden through education and support
evidence_summary: Social worker interventions addressing social determinants of health and providing psychosocial support have been shown to improve quality of life, reduce barriers to care, and enhance self-care behaviors in heart failure patients.
citation: Addressing Social Determinants of Health in the Care of Patients With Heart Failure
